rows.name: iso2022_jp
rows.source:
import codecs
text = input()
print('input', text)
info = codecs.lookup('iso2022_jp')
data = info.encode(text)[0]
decoder = info.incrementaldecoder()
print(repr(data))
print(repr(decoder.decode(data[:1])), decoder.getstate())
print(repr(decoder.decode(data[1:], True)), decoder.getstate())
